user.title: HA Irrigation Controller
user.description: Pick the pump and sensors this controller drives, then set the cycle start times. Zones are added afterwards.

data_description.pump_switch: The switch that powers the pump feeding your valves.
data_description.rain_sensor: A sensor reporting accumulated precipitation in millimetres. Required: watering is modulated by rainfall.
data_description.temperature_sensor: Optional. Stored for future weather coefficients; it is not used in this version.
data_description.humidity_sensor: Optional. Stored for future weather coefficients; it is not used in this version.
data_description.morning_enabled: Off by default: in spring the evening cycle alone is usually enough. The evening cycle always runs.
data_description.morning_start: Local time the morning cycle starts, when it is enabled.
data_description.evening_start: Local time the evening cycle starts.

error.start_times_conflict: The morning and evening cycles cannot start at the same time. Change one of them, or turn the morning cycle off.
